summary.zh-CN: 概述指定书目的内容并给出有依据的评价，适合要求提交阅读报告或书评的课程。
summary.en: Summarises an assigned book and judges it on stated grounds; suited to courses that ask for a reading report or review.

whenToUse.zh-CN: 老师指定了书目，要求读后提交报告或书评
whenToUse.en: The assignment names a book and asks for a report or review

whenToUse.zh-CN: 既要说明书里讲什么，也要给出自己的判断
whenToUse.en: Both what the book says and your own judgement are required

whenToUse.zh-CN: 篇幅有限，概述不能挤掉评价
whenToUse.en: Space is limited, so summary must not crowd out evaluation

focus.zh-CN: 给出作品、作者与版本信息，说明评价角度与标准，并交代全文顺序。
focus.en: Give the work, author and edition, state the angle and criteria of the evaluation, and the order of the paper.

focus.zh-CN: 写清书名、作者、版本与出版信息，一句话说明作者立场或学术背景；信息要准确可查。
focus.en: Give title, author, edition and publication details accurately, plus one line on the author's standing or background.

focus.zh-CN: 说明从哪个角度评价、用什么标准；标准先行，评价才有依据。
focus.en: State the angle of evaluation and the criteria; naming the criteria first is what makes the judgement accountable.

focus.zh-CN: 提供理解评价所必需的背景：核心问题、主要论证线索与写作背景；概述为评价服务，不逐章复述。
focus.en: Give only what the evaluation needs: the core question, the main lines of argument and the context of writing. No chapter-by-chapter retelling.

focus.zh-CN: 说明全书要回答什么问题、主张什么；用作者自己的话说，再点明关键章节。
focus.en: Say what question the book answers and what it claims, in the author's own terms, and point to the chapters that carry it.

focus.zh-CN: 按论证结构而非章节顺序概述，指出每一环依赖什么；概述控制在评价所需的范围。
focus.en: Summarise by argument structure rather than chapter order, showing what each step relies on; keep it to what the evaluation needs.

focus.zh-CN: 交代成书背景、对话对象与作者的立场偏向；这往往是评价的切入点。
focus.en: Give the context of writing, who the book answers and where the author stands; this is often where the evaluation starts.

focus.zh-CN: 结合具体文本与理由评价：论证是否有效、材料用得如何、与同类作品相比怎样、哪里有不足；每项判断都要落到原文。
focus.en: Judge against the text itself: whether the argument holds, how the material is used, how it compares with similar works and where it falls short. Anchor every judgement in the text.

focus.zh-CN: 检查关键推理是否成立、有无跳步或循环论证；指出具体位置，不泛泛而谈。
focus.en: Check whether the key inferences hold and whether there are leaps or circularity; point to the place, not the general impression.

focus.zh-CN: 评价材料是否支撑结论、有无选择性引用或数据误用；举例说明。
focus.en: Assess whether the material supports the conclusions and whether there is selective quotation or misuse of data; give examples.

focus.zh-CN: 与观点相近或相反的作品对照，说明本书的贡献与位置；比较对象要确实可比。
focus.en: Set the book against works that agree or disagree, locating its contribution; compare only with genuinely comparable works.

focus.zh-CN: 指出真正的不足或可以争论的地方，并说明理由；夸奖和批评都要有依据。
focus.en: Name the real weaknesses or the points open to dispute, with reasons; praise and criticism both need grounds.

focus.zh-CN: 给出总体判断，说明这部作品对谁有什么阅读价值；不重复概述。
focus.en: Give the overall judgement and say what the work is worth reading for, and for whom; do not repeat the summary.

description.zh-CN: 摘要（作品、核心论点与总体判断）
description.en: Abstract: the work, its core claim and the overall judgement

description.zh-CN: 书目信息（引用格式按老师要求）
description.en: Publication details, formatted as the assignment requires

methodNotes.zh-CN: 概述与评价要分开：概述提供理解评价所需的背景，评价给出有依据的判断。概述与评价的比例按作业要求调整；书目信息是元数据，不占正文篇幅。
methodNotes.en: Keep summary and evaluation apart: the summary supplies what the evaluation needs, the evaluation gives a grounded judgement. Adjust the ratio to the assignment; publication details are metadata and take no body share.
